extracted.intended_audience: aspiring creative writers; general readers seeking practical writing advice
extracted.subtask_description: Practical, chapter-based guidance for creative writers on getting started, drafting, revising, craft (character, plot, dialogue), mindset, and publication. rubrics_metrics.description: The anecdote recounted on the page: when overwhelmed by a big assignment, tackle it 'bird by bird' — one small piece at a time.
